candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return DSM - 1m
verified_facts: The 1m first-return DSM uses the first or only laser return and includes vehicles, buildings, vegetation and terrain where the first return is ground.
The composite is derived from National LIDAR Programme surveys and the individual source surveys are stated at +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: A 1m first-return DSM is not bare-earth DTM and cannot be substituted for parcel ground elevation merely because its grid is fine.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return DSM - 2m
verified_facts: The 2m first-return DSM is also generated from first or only returns and includes surface objects as well as terrain.
It is a merged national-programme composite whose contributing surveys retain the stated +/-15cm RMSE vertical-accuracy contract.
semantic_limits: Changing grid resolution from 1m to 2m changes spatial sampling, not the source survey's vertical-accuracy statement, and neither product is a bare-earth substitute.
